# chemparseplot

> Pure-Python parsers and unit-aware plotters for computational chemistry outputs (eOn, ORCA, ChemGP, PLUMED).

Docs: https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/
Repo: https://github.com/HaoZeke/chemparseplot
PyPI / conda-forge: chemparseplot
Context7: /haozeke/chemparseplot

This file is a map of the published pages. It does not restate the API.
Import the public `chemparseplot` parse and plot API. Do not import private `_` modules.

## eOn options

eOn configuration options are not listed here. The option schema is published with the eOn docs, not restated here: [eOn user guide](https://eondocs.org/user_guide/).

## Getting started

- [Home](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/): parsers, plotters, and the documentation map
- [Quickstart](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/quickstart): install and a minimal parse and plot
- [Installation](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/installation): package install
- [Features](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/features): parse, project, and plot

## Tutorials

- [Tutorial introduction](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/tutorials/): tutorial index
- [ORCA NEB parsing and plotting](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/tutorials/orca_neb): end-to-end ORCA NEB tutorial
- [Contributing tutorials](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/tutorials/contribdoc): how tutorial notebooks are written
- [ChemGP tutorials](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/tutorials/chemgp/): GP optimization plots
- [ChemGP 1D plots](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/tutorials/chemgp/convergence): convergence, RFF, profile, and FPS
- [ChemGP 2D plots](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/tutorials/chemgp/surfaces): surfaces, NLL, variance, trust, and sensitivity
- [Geometry scan](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/tutorials/orca/geomscan): ORCA geometry-scan plots
- [eOn saddle search analysis](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/tutorials/eon/saddle): parse saddle-search results

## How-to

- [How-to guides](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/howto/): goal-oriented guides
- [Installation guide](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/howto/install): install for development and use
- [Parse ORCA NEB calculations](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/howto/parse_orca_neb): energies and barriers from ORCA NEB
- [Parse eOn NEB calculations](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/howto/parse_eon_neb): data from eOn NEB output
- [Create publication NEB figures](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/howto/create_neb_figures): NEB, dimer, and minimization figures
- [Draw surrogate-assisted searches](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/howto/surrogate_search_figures): figures from gpr_optim or ML-NEB output

- [Run tests and check coverage](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/howto/dev_testing): test and coverage commands

## Install

```sh
uv add chemparseplot
# or
pip install chemparseplot
```
